description: Search public YouTube videos, channels, or playlists from the verified results page. Extracts native ytInitialData/lockup fields, follows continuation pagination internally, and uses a partial visible-DOM fallback when page data drifts.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum results, strict positive integer from 1 to 100

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Search result type: video, channel, or playlist

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Standard sort: default (YouTube relevance), popular (YouTube popular); latest is accepted but reported in ignoredParams because no stable current mapping was verified

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Upload-date range day, week, month, year, or all; applied to video/default search when supported
